articles.description: Following Seiya Suzuki’s and Shota Imanaga’s departures to free agency, the Chicago Cubs are maintaining their presence in Japan by agreeing to deals with Hiromi Itoh and Teruaki Sato.

articles.description: The Chicago Cubs made their first big move for the starting rotation on Monday night by agreeing to a multi-year deal with lefty starter Trevor Rogers, sources told the Tribune.
articles.title: Chicago Cubs agree to a multi-year deal with lefty starter Trevor Rogers, per sources

articles.description: Chase Meidroth became the first second baseman in Chicago White Sox history to win a Silver Slugger Award on Tuesday. Winners also included the Cubs’ Pete Crow-Armstrong and Alex Bregman.
